text:
Elaine: Heads-up — the launch post performance dash shows a weird jump for cohort 'launch-post-series-a' yesterday: 2.3k -> 5.8k inbound leads. Dash link: https://redwood.app/dash/launchposts?cohort=series-a. Anyone seeing this?
Matt: Yeah I see it. Looks like EU is the bulk of the spike. Conv rate for that cohort fell ~30%. Could be bot/referral spam :thinking_face:
Ravi: I ran a quick query, here's the tail:
```sql
SELECT referrer, count(*) as leads, min(created_at)
FROM incoming_leads
WHERE campaign = 'launch_post_series_a'
  AND created_at >= '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY referrer
ORDER BY leads DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Most of the extra rows are from referrer 'partner_x' around 02:00 UTC.
Sofia: We did a routing pass yesterday morning — enabled the 'legacy-utm-clean' mapping to catch malformed utms. @Anna (ops) did the deploy. Could that have duplicated mapping and doubled attribution?
deploy-bot: routing-rule-update deployed at 2026-03-18T02:15Z by Anna (ops) (change-id: abc123)
Anna (ops): Confirming — the mapping for source 'launch_series_a' was accidentally added twice in the mapping table during the cleanups. Rolling back now.
Elaine: If you roll back, can someone re-run a dedupe + sample-check? I exported a 100-row sample of lead_ids and some utm params. Putting sample in GDrive. I'll link after this.
Matt: On it. I'll run a dedupe check against lead_id and gclid, then post a checksum. ETA ~15m :clock3:
Ravi: One more thing — our dashboard uses last-touch by default for attribution. With these routing changes, last-touch will amplify same-day changes. For the weekly KPI review, recommend we toggle to a first-touch overlay or include a footnote about attribution window.
Sofia: Good flag. I'll add a note in the KPI doc and update the dashboard blurb to call out attribution window and the routing deploy.
deploy-bot: rollback complete at 2026-03-18T02:29Z (change-id: abc123)
Anna (ops): Rollback finished and mapping normalized. I'll run the mapping sanity script now and surface any lingering duplicates.
Elaine: Thanks all. Once Matt confirms dedupe, I'll add a short incident note in the weekly KPI review and close this thread.
Matt: Dedupe check done — sample adjusted, no duplicates once rollback applied. Posting CSV to the drive. :thumbsup:
